ShortDescription.Value: Leave city building and live in your city: walk, drive through your own traffic, and work as a taxi, delivery, freight or bus driver. Earn money, buy vehicles, run a company.

Publish.LongDescription:
Drive the City II lets you leave city building and live inside the city you built. Switch to a character, walk to a vehicle, drive your own road network through real city traffic, take jobs, earn money, and go back to building at any time.
**Development build: back up your saves.** Tested on game version 1.6.2f1 (Steam, Windows 11). Most in-game tests used the project's simulated test input; the core loop was also run with real keys. The gamepad bindings are untested.
## What you can do * Walk and run on the sidewalks of your own city, with third- and first-person cameras. * Drive a rental, your own vehicles, or (sandbox mode) any parked city car or one stopped in traffic; the game parks it again when you get out. City traffic, buildings and poles are solid, and traffic stops behind you. Buses and trucks drive through small street props (poles, signs, posts) like the game's own buses and trucks. * Careers: taxi fares, urban deliveries, rigid-truck freight, and bus shifts on your city's own bus lines. Pay, XP, reputation and unlocks per career. * Garage: rent, buy and sell vehicles; fuel and wear; roadside help and towing at service points (parking facilities and depots). * A home and a garage, timed checkpoint and parking challenges, and a simulated transport company with drivers and contracts. * English and Portuguese (Brazil).
## How to start Load a city and press **F8** (or the "Drive the City" button, top left). Press **Tab** for jobs, garage, company, challenges and profile. In the Garage, choose **Rent** on the basic rental compact (always available), walk to it and press **E**. Then Tab, Jobs, pick Taxi and accept an offer.
## Controls (change them in Options, Drive the City II, Controls) * F8: enter or leave character mode * W A S D: walk or drive; Shift: run; Space: handbrake * E: enter or leave a vehicle; V: camera * Tab: panel; Backspace: move to a safe spot; Alt (hold): free the mouse
## Saves and compatibility * Career data is stored inside each city save. Your character and vehicles are never written into the city, and your cities keep loading if you remove the mod. * Do not use it together with the Beta Test Driving Mod: Drive the City II detects it and stays inactive.
## Known issues * An unfocused game window counts as paused, so character mode cannot start then. * Very tight turns (hairpins) are hard work for a 12.7 m bus; reverse to straighten up, or press Backspace.
## Source code and bug reports Open source under the MIT License: https://github.com/michelbr84/DriveTheCityII . Please report bugs as GitHub issues. Most of the code was written with AI coding agents (Claude Code) under the author's direction; every "tested" claim in the project points to a recorded test run.
## Português (Brasil) Saia do modo construção e viva na cidade que você construiu: ande, dirija pelo seu próprio trânsito e trabalhe como taxista, entregador, caminhoneiro ou motorista de ônibus. Carregue uma cidade e aperte **F8**; **Tab** abre o painel (Trabalhos, Garagem, Empresa, Desafios, Perfil). Versão de desenvolvimento: faça backup dos seus saves. O idioma do mod fica em Opções, Drive the City II, Geral.

ChangeLog.Value: 0.2.0: parked city cars can be borrowed in sandbox mode (the game parks them again afterwards); buses and trucks no longer stop on small street props in narrow junctions; a borrowed car saved while driven no longer stays frozen in the road after loading (older saves are repaired on load); vehicles stored in garages are no longer invisible walls.
